description: Figure 6(a) is a pie chart illustrating the distribution of video types in the benchmark dataset. The chart is divided into 14 distinct segments, each representing a different video category and labeled with its corresponding percentage. The largest segment is "People Blogs" at 17.2%, followed by "Entertainment" at 13.9% and "Education" at 8.7%. Other categories include "Howto Style" (9.7%), "Sports" (7.7%), "Gaming" (6.4%), "Travel Events" (6.4%), "Comedy" (6.4%), "Science Technology" (5.6%), "News Politics" (4.6%), "Pets Animals" (4.3%), "Autos Vehicles" (4.8%), "Music" (3.9%), "Film Animation" (4.6%), and "Howto Style" (9.7%). The segments are color-coded, with each category having a unique color, and the percentage for each is clearly labeled within or adjacent to its respective slice. The chart is titled "(a) Video type distribution." and is part of a larger figure captioned "Figure 6: The basic information of our benchmark data."
